payload.summary_zh: 点签GEO 1.0.0 完成产品品牌重构、本地 Docker 部署、国产模型接入、知识库 RAG、内容审核、多渠道分发和领导交付文档整理，并继承上游安全加固基线。
payload.summary_en: Dianqian GEO 1.0.0 delivers product rebranding, local Docker deployment, model integration, knowledge-base RAG, content review, multi-channel distribution, and leadership handoff documentation on top of the upstream security baseline.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 部署或升级前先备份数据库和上传目录。现有部署升级必须停机并排空旧进程与队列，设置一次性安全确认后执行 php artisan migrate，再运行 geoflow:managed-images:readiness 与 geoflow:security-audit，确认通过后再启用图片删除门禁并重启 queue worker。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: Back up the database and uploads before deployment or upgrade. Existing installations must drain old processes and queues, set the one-time security confirmation, run php artisan migrate, then run geoflow:managed-images:readiness and geoflow:security-audit before restarting queue workers.
